contactId.title: Verified Contact Id
contactId.description: Pass the Contact Id stored from Verify Customer Identity or Register Customer. Never ask the customer for a Salesforce Id. Never invent one.

driverEmail.title: Driver Email
driverEmail.description: Driver email if different from the registered email.

dropoffDatetime.title: Drop-off Datetime
dropoffDatetime.description: Pass drop-off date and time as the customer confirmed. Must be after pickup.

dropoffLocation.title: Drop-off Location
dropoffLocation.description: Pass the drop-off location the customer stated. If they only gave one place, confirm they want the same drop-off, then pass it.

flightNumber.title: Flight Number
flightNumber.description: Pass only if they provided a flight number. Leave blank otherwise.

pickupDatetime.title: Pickup Datetime
pickupDatetime.description: Pass pickup date and time as the customer confirmed. Do not default to today.

pickupLocation.title: Pickup Location
pickupLocation.description: Pass the pickup location the customer stated. If unclear, ask before calling.

vehicleClass.title: Vehicle Class
vehicleClass.description: Pass the class they asked for (for example Compact, SUV, Van). If they are unsure, ask before calling.
